clips.title: The story
paras: Blueleaf Tubers is a retrieval contract commissioned by the goblin merchant Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. Seeking to profit from a rare subterranean delicacy, Mizzyrix equips adventurers with trained snufflenose gophers to locate and dig up the tubers buried inside the thorned depths of Razorfen Kraul.

Blueleaf tubers are coveted across the world as a rare and lavish culinary delicacy. Despite their high value, harvesting them is notoriously difficult because they do not grow in open fields or standard wild groves. Instead, they are found almost exclusively deep in the sunless earth beneath the southern Barrens, tangled among the labyrinthine roots of Razorfen Kraul.

Because the tubers remain completely buried and virtually impossible for ordinary humanoids to spot, the Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix devised an unusual solution. By training native snufflenose gophers—creatures capable of catching the scent of a buried tuber from fifty paces away—Mizzyrix turned vermin into foraging tools. He supplies scavengers with a command stick, a ventilated crate, and an instruction manual to guide the creatures through quilboar territory.

Reclaiming the tubers requires delving into the territory of the hostile Death's Head quilboar tribe. Foragers must protect their trained gophers from the feral beasts and thorny briars of the Kraul, commanding the rodents to unearth the hidden bulbs before packing them away for transport back to Ratchet, where Mizzyrix's high-paying foreign buyers await.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world! But they're rare, very rare. The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look! That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me. They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.
It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the tubers, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got them! I can sell these to my contacts for a bundle!
Thanks for the delivery, friend! You are a great partner.
